issue.body:
Hi,

We require having some sort of system which can be used to export metrics to monitor the different open5gs programs.
For instance, we'd like to export the number of active PDP contexts / bearers at the SMF over time.

For that, we'd like to add support for counters into open5gs, adding some sort of generic API for counters, gauges, etc. As a backend/implementation for that API we are planning to use Prometheus [1], which basically requires an HTTP server to be running in the process providing the metrics (open5gs-*).
There already exists a prometheus client lib in C listed in the library list [2], prometheus-client-c [3], which actually contains 2 libraries: libprom and libpromhttp.
Libprom implements the formatting of the counters to be passed to prometheus, and libpromhttp is a really tiny library providing an http server which uses libmicrohpttd underneath. That's great because open5gs already depends on libmicrohttpd, and libmicrohttpd is so tiny that we can actually integrate all that part directly inopen5gs code.

There seems somebody already had the same idea of using libprom in open5gs in the past, so this already provides and insight of how it would look like (it may make more sense to have some generic ogs API wrapper in the middle though imho):
https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/pull/530

So, I propose something like:

1. Adding some open5gs.git/lib/metrics/ containing a generic way to define counters and operate on them
2. Adding a open5gs.git/lib/metrics/void/ containing a void implementation (empty stubs doing nothing)
3. Adding a open5gs.git/lib/metrics/prometheus/ lib which can be conditionally enabled/disabled at build time, which depends on prometheus-client-c's libprom and libmicrohttpd.
4. Using the new lib in open5gs.git/src/smf/ with a few counters to start with.

[1] https://prometheus.io/
[2] https://prometheus.io/docs/instrumenting/clientlibs/
[3] https://github.com/digitalocean/prometheus-client-c
